drivingQuestion: Whence that the judging assembly must all be fit to rule?
outcomeNote: Rav Ḥisda's derivation replaced by Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak's

segments.he: וְאֵימָא: ״עִמָּךְ״ לִשְׁכִינָה! אֶלָּא אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן בַּר יִצְחָק, אָמַר קְרָא: ״וְנָשְׂאוּ אִתָּךְ״ – ״אִתָּךְ״ בְּדוֹמִין לָךְ.
segments.en: The Gemara challenges: «And say that» the term «“with you,”» means that they shall be like Moses in that they will all be fit «for the Divine Presence» to rest upon them. «Rather, Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak says» that it is derived as «the verse states» in the context of the advice that Yitro gave to Moses: “And they shall judge the people at all times…and ease your burden from upon you «and bear it with you”» (Exodus 18:22). «“With you”» is interpreted to mean: «Similar to you.»
